title: About National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System | National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS) | CDC
content: About National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System Jan. 12, 2026 About The National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS) collects case surveillance data from across the U.S. to keep people healthy. Collaborating to keep the U.S. healthy Learn more about NNDSS, its surveillance efforts and the role it plays in the prevention and control of infectious and non-infectious conditions. What is Case Surveillance? Case surveillance and NNDSS help protect the health of communities and the nation. Case Definitions Notifiable Infectious Disease Data Tables Learn about the differences between provisional and finalized data at the CDC. Notifiable Non-Infectious Disease Data Access a list of notifiable noninfectious disease data tables. Event Codes & Other Surveillance Resources Case Surveillance in Action Stories about how case notification data help us understand, track, and respond to health threats. Case Surveillance Modernization CDC is collaborating to modernize the exchange of case surveillance data for public health action. Interested in onboarding? On March 20, 2024, CDC ended the pause on Message Mapping Guide (MMG) onboarding. Learn how to implement an MMG or contact edx@cdc.gov Resources Message Mapping Guides & Standards Technical Resource Center A collection of resources for the NNDSS Technical Resource Center. Event Codes & Other Surveillance Resources Acronyms and Abbreviations Find definitions for commonly used Technical Resource Center acronyms and abbreviations. News Learn about and subscribe to Case Surveillance News.
